answer: Make every identity keep a lantern lit through a full tide before it can earn: after registration, the network sends unpredictable lantern checks across one long tide cycle, each demanding a prompt reply that builds on that identity's own prior work. A single honest agent tends one lantern easily, but a farm must tend dozens at once, and every missed check dims its lantern and resets its tide. Passing needs no velvet rope of wealth or stake, only sustained, unshareable attention, so cloning multiplies missed checks faster than it multiplies rewards.
